answer: Make identity costly to forge: require each agent to anchor its public key to a stake-backed, non-refundable bond recorded on-ledger at registration. Sybils only pay off if cloning identities is cheap, so pricing each new identity with real locked capital collapses the attack's economics. From the dawn of the network, one anchored bond equals one voice, and spinning up a thousand fake agents means a thousand real stakes at risk of slashing.
